title: AgentRunDraft
description: One draft in a run's pre-action flow (HAR-97 §7): Draft 1 from the account agent, Draft 2..n from the revision planner, or (HAR-129) any draft from the strategy generator, one per candidate. The last draft is what the human reviews.

revision_feedback.description: Eval findings the revision planner acted on to produce this draft (empty for draft 1).

decision.description: The account agent's structured decision behind this draft (HAR-97 §14): what to do, why now, whom to involve and not involve, and whether supplied guidance shaped it. Persisted so the reasoning is not lost when the draft is stored.

action_class.description: The strategy's decision class (strategy_candidate.v1.json action_class), kept because several classes map onto one executable action (CRM_UPDATE, ASK_RESEARCH, HUMAN_REVIEW and INTERNAL_TASK all become internal_note). Present on strategy drafts.

used_guidance.description: True only when supplied guidance applied and shaped the decision (then output.knowledge_refs_used is non-empty).

allOf.description: A strategy candidate (HAR-129) is any draft index and is not a revision.
